_comment: THE PRODUCTION RELATIONS RECIPE (registry: rele07tr). Base = the KVKK entity champion (relations re-enabled by training; never train with enable_relations:false), data = e07tr: 850 records with TURKISH relation names (English originals kept as aliases at p=0.4). 2,000 steps, batch 4, 1 GPU (DDP is unsafe for relations training: the OOM-skip path is not collective), encoder 1e-5 / task 5e-4, constant after 20 warm-up steps, bf16. Result: e07 test entities 96.2 / relations 69.3 (strict, thr 0.5); real documents (vekaletname_v1) 75.8 / 38.5. Override the base with --from-pretrained.
